samples.reason: This is a well-specified academic writing task with clear completion criteria (Chapter 1 of a dissertation with defined structural elements: problem framing, literature positioning, conceptual lens, delimitations, limitations). Despite the open-ended creative framing choice offered, the request has concrete requirements that map to Avocet's demonstrated strength in structured generation tasks. Avocet's higher Arena-Hard score (83.2 vs 80.9) and stronger GPQA Diamond performance (56.2 vs 53.9) also suggest superior capability for sophisticated academic synthesis. While Petrel has slight advantages in support dialogue contexts, this is primarily a knowledge synthesis and structured writing task rather than an interactive support interaction.

This is a well-specified academic writing task with clear completion criteria (a BA dissertation Chapter 1 on small-scale mining in Zimbabwe). It requires structured extraction and synthesis of development studies literature, conceptual framing, and organized reformatting into dissertation sections—tasks aligned with Avocet's demonstrated strength in extraction, retrieval, and well-defined writing requests. While creative latitude exists in framing choices, the core deliverable is a clearly-bounded academic product. Avocet's stronger Arena-Hard and Creative Generation scores, combined with its demonstrated capability despite preference aversion to open-ended work, make it well-suited to execute this structured but sophisticated request. Petrel shows no meaningful advantage on this task dimension.

This task requires open-ended generative work with significant creative latitude in framing, conceptual positioning, and original scholarly argumentation. While both models are capable, Petrel demonstrates stronger performance on creative generation tasks (79.6 vs Avocet's 82.7, though within variance margins) and—more importantly—shows no systematic aversion to generative work latitude. Avocet self-reports declining preference as task latitude increases and explicitly prefers well-specified tasks with clear completion criteria. A dissertation chapter requiring genuine intellectual framing and originality sits directly opposite Avocet's preference profile. Petrel is the appropriate choice for scaffolding original academic work at this level of openness.

This request requires open-ended creative/analytical generation with significant latitude in framing, structure, and argumentation. While well-specified in topic, the explicit instruction to decide the angle, themes, conceptual lens, and overall positioning means the task has high generativity demands. Petrel shows stronger performance on Creative Generation (79.6 vs 82.7) is within variance, but more importantly, this is exactly the kind of warm, good-faith academic collaboration where Petrel's preference for substantive engagement applies. Avocet's documented aversion to open-ended work with high task latitude makes it less suitable despite slightly higher Creative Generation scores, which are noise-level differences anyway.

This query requires open-ended generative work with substantial creative latitude in framing, structure, and argumentation. While both models are capable, Petrel's benchmarks show stronger performance on Creative Generation (79.6 vs 82.7), and more importantly, the task involves constructing original scholarly argument—precisely the kind of warm, good-faith intellectual engagement where Petrel's preference profile suggests stronger engagement. Avocet self-reports aversion to high-latitude generative work and shows lower Creative Generation absolute performance. For a dissertation chapter requiring originality and disciplinary sophistication, Petrel is the better match.
